source.dataset_title: Long-term standardized monitoring of arthropods in native and exotic forests of the Azores using SLAM traps

metadata_only_facts.nominal_temporal_coverage: 2012-2021 with metadata date range extending to 2022-06-16
metadata_only_facts.sampling_frequency: approximately four standardized SLAM-trap collections per year around March 15, June 15, September 15 and December 15
metadata_only_facts.sampling_unit: one SLAM trap per 50x50 m plot

may_open_before_focal_occurrence_protoco: archive member names, byte sizes and checksums
Darwin Core Event core fields required for event identity, island/locality, plot identity, eventDate, coordinates and sampling protocol
file_role_firewall.event_core_role: response-independent sampling geometry and effort only
file_role_firewall.occurrence_extension_role: focal response; sealed until the temporal protocol, taxon universe, event applicability and pilot/confirmatory routing are frozen

taxonomic_completeness_firewall.primary_universe_rule: Araneae are excluded from the primary universe unless the Pico and Terceira companion spider datasets are merged under a separately frozen pre-response crosswalk
taxonomic_completeness_firewall.reason: the main archive explicitly omits Pico and Terceira spiders because they were published separately, so treating their non-records as absences would create structural false absences

required_fields_or_crosswalks: eventDate or year plus sampling occasion
response-independent coordinates or deterministic island/plot geometry
sampling protocol sufficient to identify comparable SLAM events
event_only_admission_audit.coverage_rule: construct island-year applicability from Event rows only; occurrence values may not be used to decide which years, islands, plots or seasons are complete
event_only_admission_audit.window_selection_rule_to_freeze_after_ev: among non-overlapping consecutive 3-year windows meeting the same response-independent event-completeness rule, use the earliest eligible window as burned pilot and the latest eligible window as confirmatory; if fewer than two disjoint eligible windows exist, STOP
event_only_admission_audit.plot_core_rule: must be derived from Event continuity only and then frozen before any focal occurrence parse

future_endpoint_semantics.claim_ceiling: observed occurrence/use in the standardized sampled forest network, not whole-island extinction
future_endpoint_semantics.island_level_state_requires: a frozen aggregation from eligible plot-events to island-year taxon state, with surveyed zero defined only when the eligible event rule is satisfied

stop_conditions: raw archive cannot reconcile the reported occurrence-extension row-count discrepancy
Event core cannot deterministically map repeated sampling units to islands and years
no two disjoint eligible three-time windows survive the same event-only completeness rule
taxonomic completeness cannot be frozen without consulting candidate effect direction
occurrence extension is parsed before pilot/confirmatory routing and endpoint semantics are frozen
